categories.name: كَلِمَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ آدَمَ
categories.nameEn: Key terms from the story of Adam

items.verse: فَقُلْنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا عَدُوٌّۭ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
items.verseEn: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.

items.verse: وَيَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
items.verseEn: And "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat from wherever you will but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

items.verse: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
items.verseEn: And they [i.e., Adam and his wife] ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.

items.verse: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا۟ فِى حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِۦ ۚ وَإِمَّا يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
items.verseEn: And when you see those who engage in [offensive] discourse concerning Our verses, then turn away from them until they enter into another conversation. And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not remain after the reminder with the wrongdoing people.

categories.name: أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ فِي سُورَةِ الْوَاقِعَةِ
categories.nameEn: Descriptions of the Companions of the Left Hand in Surah Al-Waqi'ah

items.verseEn: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
And a shade of black smoke,
And they used to persist in the great violation,

categories.name: سُخْرِيَةُ الْكَافِرِينَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي سُورَةِ الْمُطَفِّفِينَ
categories.nameEn: Mockery of the Believers by the Disbelievers in Surah Al-Mutaffifin

items.verse: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
items.verseEn: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

items.verse: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
items.verseEn: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

items.verse: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
items.verseEn: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

categories.name: جُمُوعُ التَّكْسِيرِ عَلَىٰ وَزْنِ فُعُل
categories.nameEn: Broken plurals of the pattern فُعُل in the Quran

items.verse: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
items.verseEn: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

items.verse: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
items.verseEn: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.

items.verse: وَأَنَّ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطِى مُسْتَقِيمًۭا فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
items.verseEn: And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from His way. This has He instructed you that you may become righteous.
Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

harf.hint: An underground chamber where the deceased are laid to rest
harf.arabicVerse: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍۢ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
harf.verse: 35:22 - And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allāh causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.

deduction.title: The Throne That Traveled in an Instant
deduction.intro: A figure of immense authority ruled over a wealthy kingdom blessed with riches beyond measure. When an unexpected challenge arose, this ruler faced a trial not of swords but of wisdom and faith. What unfolded would lead from the pinnacle of worldly power to a profound transformation of heart.
clues: I ruled over a kingdom blessed with riches and prosperity beyond imagination
I was a powerful monarch who received a bold letter demanding submission
My nobles counseled me about whether to fight or make peace with this far-off king
I set out with magnificent gifts to meet this distant king myself
My royal throne was brought to a far-off land in the blink of an eye, before I could return
When I entered a palace with a floor smooth as glass, I finally proclaimed my submission to Allah

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Bilqis, Queen of Sheba
The Wife of Pharaoh
The Wife of Al-Aziz
Maryam, Daughter of Imran
The Wife of Prophet Lut

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Receiving a bold letter demanding submission
Being cast into a blazing fire
Being swallowed by a great fish
Enduring years of painful illness
Witnessing the destruction of a people by a flood
trial.answer: Receiving a bold letter demanding submission

location.label: Key Element
options: A magnificent royal throne of gold and gems
A staff that parted the sea
An ark resting upon a mountain
A sacred house of worship in Makkah
A golden calf worshipped by a people
location.answer: A magnificent royal throne of gold and gems

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Submission to Allah alongside a prophet
Drowning in the sea while chasing an enemy
Being saved miraculously from a blazing fire
Exile from a garden of eternal bliss
Receiving a kingdom of immense power
outcome.answer: Submission to Allah alongside a prophet

deduction.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
deduction.verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)

scramble.hint: The divine greeting of peace and the blessed reward awaiting those who remained patient and steadfast in faith.
scramble.arabic: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
scramble.verseEn: "Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."
